## Research contract
Research/hypothesis IDs, source URL/SHA, current epistemic and lifecycle status:

## Hypothesis and falsifiers
Competing mechanisms, estimand, observables, assumptions, confounders:

## Data and temporal contract
Sources, rights, versions/hashes, asset/venue/session/timezone, unit of analysis,
event/availability/decision clocks, exclusions, measurement limits:

## Frozen design
Features/labels/horizons, train/tune/locked-test splits, purge/embargo, primary
metric, uncertainty, multiple-testing controls, regime checks, cost assumptions:

## Reproduction plan
Code revision, runtime/dependencies, seeds, approved commands, resource limits,
expected artifacts, original-vs-rerun comparison and failure retention:

## Evidence and review
- Software tests: PASS / FAIL / NOT RUN
- Code reproduction: PASS / FAIL / NOT RUN
- Empirical evaluation: PASS / FAIL / NOT RUN
- Causal identification: UNKNOWN unless explicitly justified
- Security, licensing, and data-rights review:
- Required human approval before execution or lifecycle promotion:

Phase 01 supplies this template only. Do not attach credentials or private data.
